name: Gifts
description: Recipients, occasions, gift ideas, budget, and purchase/wrapping/giving state.
captureExamples: A cookbook could be a good birthday gift for Sam.

capture.identity: Match the selected gift plan, recipient, and occasion.
exclude: Sharing private gifting intent with a wishlist's audience automatically.
capture.workflow: Keep recipient and gifting decisions private. Reference an existing wishlist item instead of copying its name, URL and product price; link actual purchases separately.

notes: A gift idea can reference an existing Shopping Wishlists list/item through wishlistItem. Linked ideas keep gifting state private and cannot duplicate name, URL, or product price fields.
Use a standalone name/URL/price only when no existing wishlist item is selected. Linking does not grant the wishlist audience access to the gift plan.
